standard-dialogue-before-the-dig-site.npc: Good day to you. My name is Terry Balando; I am an expert on digsite finds.
I am employed by the museum in Varrock to oversee all finds at this digsite. Anything you find must be reported to me.

standard-dialogue-before-the-dig-site.player: Oh, ok. If I find anything of interest I will bring it here.

standard-dialogue-before-the-dig-site.npc: Can I help you at all?

options.text: I have something I need checking out.

steps.player: I have something I need checking out.

steps.npc: Okay, give it to me and I'll have a look for you.
Good, let me know if you find anything unusual.

options.text: Can you tell me anything about the digsite?

steps.player: Can you tell me anything about the digsite?

steps.npc: Yes, indeed; I am studying the lives of the settlers. During the end of the third age there used to be a great city at the site.
Its inhabitants were humans, supporters of the god Saradomin. It's not recorded what happened to the community here.
I suspect nobody has lived here for over a millennium!

options.text: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?
Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?

steps.player: Can you tell me more about the tools an archaeologist uses?

steps.npc: Of course! Let's see now... Rock picks are for splitting rocks or scraping away soil; you can get one from a cupboard in the Education Centre.
I think you'll find them scattered about pretty much everywhere, but I know you can get one from a cupboard somewhere in the Education Centre, just like the rock pick!

steps.player: Okay, what about a specimen brush?

steps.npc: We have a bit of a shortage of those at the moment. You could try borrowing one from a workman on the site... but I don't think they'd give it willingly.

steps.player: Sounds like I'll need to be sneaky to get one of those, then... Okay - trowel?

steps.npc: Ahh... that you must earn by passing your exams! The examiner holds those.

options.text: Ask about the Desert Treasure I quest.
options.condition: If Desert Treasure I has been completed:

steps.npc: Hello again. Was that translation any use to Asgarnia?
Hello again. I am now studying this mysterious altar and its inhabitants. The markings are strange...
It refers to a god I have never heard of before, named Zaros. It must be some pagan superstition.
That was a great find; who knows what other secrets lie buried beneath the surface of our land...

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.npc: That staff is incredible! It's the same symbol that was on that talisman you found here. Does this mean you've found out more about Zaros?

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.player: I found out that he was banished, and that the people's hero was trapped in a pyramid and...

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.npc: So you're the one who found out about that. I've heard the story from my friends in the museum. Well done on being able to wield such an impressive symbol.

talking-to-him-while-the-player-is-wield.text: The dialogue continues to ask about the Digsite quest.

using-items-using-an-ancient-staff-on-hi.player: What do you think of this?

using-items-using-unidentified-liquid-on.text: All unidentified liquids in inventory are replaced with nitroglycerin.

using-items-using-unidentified-liquid-on.player: Do you know what this is?
From one of the barrels at the digsite.

using-items-using-unidentified-liquid-on.npc: This is a VERY dangerous liquid called nitroglycerin. Be careful how you handle it. Don't drop it or it will explode!

using-items-using-nitroglycerin-on-him.player: Can you tell me any more about this?

using-items-using-nitroglycerin-on-him.npc: Nitroglycerin! This is a dangerous substance. This is normally mixed with other chemicals to produce a potent compound.
Be sure not to drop it! That stuff is highly volatile...

using-items-using-ammonium-nitrate-on-hi.npc: Really, you do find the most unusual items. I know what this is - it's a strong chemical called ammonium nitrate. Why you want this I'll never know...

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-on-him.npc: Hmm, that looks dangerous. Handle it carefully and don't drop it!

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-with-c.player: See what I have done with the compound now.

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-with-c.npc: Seriously, I think you have a death wish! What on earth are you going to do with that stuff?

using-items-using-mixed-chemicals-with-c.player: I'll find a use for it!

using-items-using-the-chemical-compound-.player: What do you think about this?

using-items-using-the-chemical-compound-.npc: What have you concocted now? Just be careful when playing with chemicals!

using-items-using-nuggets-on-him.text: If the player has less than 3 nuggets:

steps.npc: I can't do much with these nuggets yet. Come back when you have 3 and I will exchange them for you.

using-items-using-nuggets-on-him.text: If the player has at least 3 nuggets:

steps.npc: Good – that's three; I can exchange them for normal gold now. You can get this refined and make a profit!

using-items-using-a-needle-on-him.npc: Hmm, yes; I wondered why this race were so well dressed! It looks like they had mastery of needlework.

using-items-using-a-rotten-apple-on-him.npc: Ew! Throw them away this instant!

using-items-using-broken-glass-on-him.player: Have a look at this glass.

using-items-using-broken-glass-on-him.npc: Hey you should be careful of that. It might cut your fingers, throw it away!

using-items-using-a-broken-arrow-on-him.player: Have a look at this arrow.

using-items-using-a-broken-arrow-on-him.npc: No doubt this arrow was shot by a strong warrior – it's split in half! It is not a valuable object though.

using-items-using-a-panning-tray-on-him.text: If the panning tray is empty:

steps.npc: I have no need for panning trays!

using-items-using-a-panning-tray-on-him.text: If the panning tray has something in it:

steps.npc: Have you searched this tray yet?
It may contain something; I don't want to get my hands dirty.

steps.text: The expert hands the tray back to you.

using-items-using-bones-on-him.player: Have a look at these bones.

using-items-using-bones-on-him.npc: Ah, yes – a fine bone example... no noticeable fractures... and in good condition. These are common cow bones, however; they have no archaeological value.

using-items-using-buttons-on-him.npc: Let's have a look. Ah, I think these are from the nobility, perhaps a royal servant?

using-items-using-a-cracked-sample-on-hi.npc: What a shame it's cracked; this looks like it would have been a good sample.

using-items-using-an-old-tooth-on-him.npc: Oh, an old tooth. It looks like it has come from a mighty being. Pity there are no tooth fairies around here!

using-items-using-a-rusty-sword-on-him.npc: Oh, it's very rusty isn't it? I'm not sure this sword belongs here, it looks very out of place.

using-items-using-a-broken-staff-on-him.player: Have a look at this staff.

using-items-using-a-broken-staff-on-him.npc: Look at this... Interesting... This appears to belong to a cleric of some kind; certainly not a follower of Saradomin, however.
I wonder if there was another civilization here before the Saradominists?

using-items-using-broken-armour-on-him.npc: It looks like the wearer of this fought a mighty battle.

using-items-using-damaged-armour-on-him.npc: How unusual. This armour doesn't seem to match with the other finds. Keep looking.

using-items-using-ceramic-remains-on-him.npc: Yes, many parts are discovered. The inhabitants of these parts were great potters.

using-items-using-ceramic-remains-on-him.player: You mean they were good at using potions?

using-items-using-ceramic-remains-on-him.npc: No, no, silly. They were known for their skill with clay.

using-items-using-a-belt-buckle-on-him.player: Have a look at this unusual item...

using-items-using-a-belt-buckle-on-him.npc: Let me see. This is a belt buckle. Not so unusual - I should imagine it came from a guard.

using-items-using-an-animal-skull-on-him.npc: Hmm, an interesting find; an animal skull for sure. Another student found one just like this today.

using-items-using-the-special-cup-on-him.text: The expert cleans off the mud.

using-items-using-the-special-cup-on-him.npc: Looks like an award cup for some small find. Perhaps it belongs to one of the students?

using-items-using-teddy-on-him.npc: Why, it looks like a teddy bear to me. Perhaps someone's lucky mascot!

using-items-using-an-old-boot-on-him.npc: Ah yes, an old boot. Not really an ancient artefact, is it?

using-items-using-another-ancient-talism.text: The expert has already seen the talisman.

using-items-using-the-invitation-letter-.npc: There's no point in giving me this back!

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-du.player: I found this in a hidden cavern beneath the digsite.
There is an altar down there. The place is crawling with skeletons!

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-du.npc: This is an amazing discovery! All this while we were convinced that no other race had lived here.
It seems the followers of Saradomin have tried to cover up the evidence of the Zaros altar. This whole city must have been built over it!
Thanks for your help; your sharp eyes have spotted what many have missed. Here, take this gold as your reward.

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-du.text: The expert gives you 2 gold bars as payment.

using-items-using-stone-tablet-on-him-po.npc: I don't need another tablet! One is enough, thank you.
